ai_summary: Aaron Industries Limited's upcoming 13th AGM includes proposals for routine financial statement adoption and a Rs. 0.50 per share dividend. Materially, shareholders will vote on simultaneously revising the remuneration and re-appointing Chairman & MD Amar Doshi and Whole-Time Director Karan Doshi for new three-year terms effective February 2027. This bundled approval for two Doshi family members, without explicit revised remuneration figures in the notice, suggests a need for closer shareholder scrutiny on executive compensation and corporate governance.
